## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering change.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated
- [ ] `gradle :shared:desktopTest` passes
- [ ] `gradle :desktopApp:compileKotlin` passes
- [ ] `gradle :androidApp:assembleDebug` passes when Android code changes
- [ ] `gradle :androidApp:lintDebug` passes when Android code changes
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Accessibility and reduced-motion behavior reviewed for UI changes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or private endpoints added

## Screenshots

Add captures for meaningful UI changes when practical.
